+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,397 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoytypev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+	"k8s.io/utils/ptr"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/pluginsdk/ir"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/pluginsdk/policy"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	spec *kgateway.ConsistentHash
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	if c == nil && other == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || other == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	otherIR, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	return reflect.DeepEqual(c.spec, otherIR.spec)
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil || c.spec == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if c.spec.Disable != nil && *c.spec.Disable {
+		if len(c.spec.Headers) > 0 || len(c.spec.Cookies) > 0 || len(c.spec.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(c.spec.FilterState) > 0 || c.spec.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other consistentHash fields may be set")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, cookie := range c.spec.Cookies {
+		if cookie.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseDurationOrSeconds(cookie.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", cookie.TTL, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	deduped := deduplicateConsistentHash(spec.ConsistentHash)
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		spec: deduped,
+	}
+}
+
+func deduplicateConsistentHash(ch *kgateway.ConsistentHash) *kgateway.ConsistentHash {
+	if ch == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	res := &kgateway.ConsistentHash{}
+	if ch.Disable != nil {
+		res.Disable = ptr.To(*ch.Disable)
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate Headers by headerName (case-insensitive)
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if !seen[key] {
+				seen[key] = true
+				res.Headers = append(res.Headers, h)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate Cookies by name (case-sensitive)
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			if !seen[c.Name] {
+				seen[c.Name] = true
+				res.Cookies = append(res.Cookies, c)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate QueryParameters by name (case-sensitive)
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			if !seen[q.Name] {
+				seen[q.Name] = true
+				res.QueryParameters = append(res.QueryParameters, q)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Deduplicate FilterState by key (case-sensitive)
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+			if !seen[f.Key] {
+				seen[f.Key] = true
+				res.FilterState = append(res.FilterState, f)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// SourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		res.SourceIp = &kgateway.SourceIpHashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	return res
+}
+
+func parseDurationOrSeconds(ttlStr string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		return d, nil
+	}
+	if sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		return time.Duration(sec) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid duration format: %s", ttlStr)
+}
+
+func buildHashPolicies(ch *kgateway.ConsistentHash) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if ch == nil || (ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable) {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var entries []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: h.Terminal,
+		}
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoytypev3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoytypev3.RegexMatcher{
+					EngineType: &envoytypev3.RegexMatcher_GoogleRe2{
+						GoogleRe2: &envoytypev3.RegexMatcher_GoogleRE2{},
+					},
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hp.PolicySpecifier = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+			Header: headerPolicy,
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: c.Terminal,
+		}
+		cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: c.Path,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			d, err := parseDurationOrSeconds(c.TTL)
+			if err == nil {
+				cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+			}
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		hp.PolicySpecifier = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+			Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: q.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: f.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		entries = append(entries, hp)
+	}
+
+	// If consistentHash was specified (even as {}) and no sub-fields were specified,
+	// default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false.
+	if len(entries) == 0 {
+		entries = append(entries, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: false,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	return entries
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	p1Field := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	p2Field := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if p2Field == nil || p2Field.spec == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1Field == nil || p1Field.spec == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			spec: deepCopyConsistentHash(p2Field.spec),
+		}
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	p1CH := p1Field.spec
+	p2CH := p2Field.spec
+
+	// If p1 has disable == true, p1 overrides p2 and suppresses consistent hashing.
+	if p1CH.Disable != nil && *p1CH.Disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Headers (case-insensitive key)
+	if len(p2CH.Headers) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, h := range p1CH.Headers {
+			seen[strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)] = true
+		}
+		for _, h := range p2CH.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if !seen[key] {
+				seen[key] = true
+				p1CH.Headers = append(p1CH.Headers, h)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Cookies (case-sensitive key)
+	if len(p2CH.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, c := range p1CH.Cookies {
+			seen[c.Name] = true
+		}
+		for _, c := range p2CH.Cookies {
+			if !seen[c.Name] {
+				seen[c.Name] = true
+				p1CH.Cookies = append(p1CH.Cookies, c)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// QueryParameters (case-sensitive key)
+	if len(p2CH.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, q := range p1CH.QueryParameters {
+			seen[q.Name] = true
+		}
+		for _, q := range p2CH.QueryParameters {
+			if !seen[q.Name] {
+				seen[q.Name] = true
+				p1CH.QueryParameters = append(p1CH.QueryParameters, q)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// FilterState (case-sensitive key)
+	if len(p2CH.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]bool)
+		for _, f := range p1CH.FilterState {
+			seen[f.Key] = true
+		}
+		for _, f := range p2CH.FilterState {
+			if !seen[f.Key] {
+				seen[f.Key] = true
+				p1CH.FilterState = append(p1CH.FilterState, f)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// SourceIp: retains higher priority policy's (p1's) value even when unset.
+	// So p1CH.SourceIp is NOT modified.
+
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}
+
+func deepCopyConsistentHash(ch *kgateway.ConsistentHash) *kgateway.ConsistentHash {
+	if ch == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &kgateway.ConsistentHash{}
+	if ch.Disable != nil {
+		out.Disable = ptr.To(*ch.Disable)
+	}
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		out.Headers = make([]kgateway.RegexHeaderHashPolicy, len(ch.Headers))
+		for i, h := range ch.Headers {
+			out.Headers[i] = h
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				out.Headers[i].RegexRewrite = &kgateway.RegexRewrite{
+					Pattern:      h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		out.Cookies = make([]kgateway.CookieHashPolicy, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for i, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			out.Cookies[i] = c
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				out.Cookies[i].Attributes = make([]kgateway.CookieAttribute, len(c.Attributes))
+				copy(out.Cookies[i].Attributes, c.Attributes)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		out.QueryParameters = make([]kgateway.QueryParameterHashPolicy, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		copy(out.QueryParameters, ch.QueryParameters)
+	}
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		out.FilterState = make([]kgateway.FilterStateHashPolicy, len(ch.FilterState))
+		copy(out.FilterState, ch.FilterState)
+	}
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		out.SourceIp = &kgateway.SourceIpHashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
